LESSON: HANDLING HAZARDOUS SUBSTANCES

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Foundations of Pre - Technical Studies
Topic 1.2: Handling Hazardous Substances

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Handling Hazardous Substances
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why are hazardous substances labelled?

1. identify hazardous substances found in the environment
2. classify hazardous substances found in the locality
3. describe safe ways of handling hazardous substances in the environment
4. appreciate the importance of observing safety when handling hazardous substances
